messages:
maria: quick thought — users keep saving per-route views that include model filters and then get surprised about which quota/route the savedquery actually uses :thinking:
lucas: can you paste an example? is this the thing where saved view stores both `route_id` and `model_id` but the console applies route-routing at render?
sam: yup. we saw 3 support tickets this week where customers expected the saved query to lock model+route but our runtime reroutes to cheaper model by policy
maria: exactly. proposal: surface on save a tiny explainer: 
- which routing policy will be used when replaying the view
- estimated token burn (based on sampled telemetry)
- a checkbox to pin model OR to allow routing fallback
ana: typo: ana:) also need to decide API shape. current POST /saved-views accepts {filters, name, scope}. Where do we put routing intent? maybe {routing_hint: "pin_model"|"allow_fallback"} or {pinned_model_id}
kevin: i'd prefer explicit pinned_model_id. routing_hint is vague and will cause drift. if pinned_model_id present, console should send it as part of query to the route service and runtime must respect or reject with 4xx
lucas: re: telemetry estimates — we can compute sample-based burn in telemetry service. sample response: ```estimated_tokens": 1.2k, "median_latency_ms": 210``` include a confidence band
maria: UX: show inline badge on saved queries: "Pinned model" vs "Routable" and a tooltip explaining SLA/cost tradeoffs. default to routable for enterprise?
kevin: default to routable for self-serve, pinned for enterprise customers on Dedicated/private plans? product callout needed
sam: rollout: feature flag per-org + canary 1% orgs. devx-bot: deploy queued for feature/quicksave-routing-hint - sha: a1b2c3 - canary: 1%
nana: (ana) quick note — ensure savedviews search and export include routing metadata so downstream billing/telemetry join works
maria: great — i'll sketch the tiny modal copy and API proto. lucas/kevin can you weigh in on runtime reject behavior? if pinned_model_id not available in region, should we fall back or reject?
kevin: reject with a helpful error and suggestion: "model not available in region — select fallback or remove pin". we should not silently route away when pin explicitly set
lucas: ack. i'll update server contract and telemetry tags: saved_view_id, routing_intent, pinned_model_id, estimated_tokens_sample
maria: thanks all. i'll drop a short design PR and link the API shape here shortly :thumbsup:
